title: The sheaf of homomorphisms from the pushforward of the structure sheaf along an affine morphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter duality.tex (Duality for Schemes)

difficulty_reason: For an affine morphism f : X -> Y, the lemma asserts that SheafHom(f_*O_Y, -) is a right adjoint to the restriction functor Mod(f_*O_Y) -> Mod(O_X), and computes the sections over an affine open U in X as Hom_A(B, F(U)) with A = O_X(U) and B = O_Y(f^{-1}(U)) (statement lines 2704-2715). The proof derives the adjunction from Modules, Lemma labelled modules-lemma-adjoint-tensor-restrict, then identifies f_*O_Y with the quasi-coherent sheaf corresponding to B regarded as an A-module because f is affine, and reads off the section description from Schemes, Lemma labelled schemes-lemma-compare-constructions (proof lines 2717-2724). Identifying the pushforward of the structure sheaf with the quasi-coherent sheaf attached to the ring B and matching the two descriptions of the sections is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
